events.text: 64 identical supplied replicating cells, four basic genes. Variable genomes and local signals drive actual cell division and attachment. No tissue stages, adult bodies, optimizer or automatic replacement.

Physical cellular habitat: finite conserved chemical pools, diffusion and fluid transport. Genes regulate material synthesis; bonds and contraction follow material stores. Chemistry is a reduced model, not molecular abiogenesis.
Volcanic disturbance #1 raised local terrain, released tracked minerals and heated nearby habitat.
